title: After a Total Hip Replacement — Precautions, Walking and Strength

hook.en: Most people walk the day after a hip replacement, but the right advice on movement, precautions and strength decides how well and how safely they recover.
hook.ur: Zyada tar log hip replacement ke agle din chalte hain, magar harkat, ehtiyat aur taaqat par sahi mashwara tay karta hai ke woh kitna achha aur mehfooz theek hote hain.

goal.en: By the end, you'll mobilise a patient safely after a hip replacement, explain the surgeon's precautions and why they differ, plan strength and walking progression, and recognise a dislocation, infection or clot.
goal.ur: End tak aap hip replacement ke baad mareez ko mehfooz tareeqe se harkat dilayenge, surgeon ki ehtiyatein aur unka farq samjhayenge, taaqat aur chalne ki progression ka plan banayenge, aur dislocation, infection ya clot pehchanenge.

text.en: Mobilise early: standing and walking with an aid on the day of or after surgery. **Precautions** depend on the **approach** the surgeon used. After a **posterior** approach, the usual advice protects the back of the joint: avoid bending the hip far past a right angle, crossing the legs and turning the knee inwards. Newer evidence suggests strict rules may be needed less often, but you must **always follow the surgeon's written instructions** and explain them clearly.
text.ur: Jaldi harkat karwayein: surgery ke din ya agle din sahare ke saath khara karna aur chalana. **Ehtiyatein** surgeon ke istemal kiye gaye **approach** par munhasir hain. **Posterior** approach ke baad aam mashwara joint ke peeche hissay ko bachata hai: hip ko seedhe zaviye se bohat zyada na modein, taangein cross na karein aur knee ko andar ki taraf na ghumayein. Naya evidence batata hai ke sakht qawaid kam ki zaroorat ho sakti hai, magar aap ko **hamesha surgeon ki likhi hidayat** maanni aur saaf samjhani hai.

text.en: Think of the new hip as a **ball in a socket that is still healing in its frame**. The metal ball is stable, but the soft tissue around it is like a freshly stitched pocket. For the first weeks, the aim is to keep it from being pulled out while the pocket heals and the muscles regain their job of holding the ball in place.
text.ur: Naye hip ko **pyaale mein gend jo abhi apne dhaanche mein bhar rahi hai** samjhein. Dhaatu ki gend sthir hai, magar iske gird narm tissue taaza silai hui jeb ki tarah hai. Pehle kuch haftay maqsad yeh hai ke jeb bharne tak gend bahar na khinche aur muscles gend ko apni jagah par rakhne ka kaam dobara seekh lein.

title.ur: Total hip replacement ke baad rehab

steps.title: Check the instructions
steps.detail: Read the surgeon's operation note and written precautions, the approach used and any weight-bearing limits before you mobilise. Ask the patient what they were told. || Hidayat dekhein

steps.title: Get up and walk
steps.detail: Teach getting in and out of bed, sit-to-stand with the weight through both legs and walking with a frame or crutches, then stairs. Check pain, dizziness and wound before and after. || Uthayein aur chalayein

steps.title: Strengthen the hip
steps.detail: Begin with gluteal sets, bridging and standing hip abduction within the precautions, then add sit-to-stand, step-ups and balance work. Walking distance rises steadily. || Hip ko mazboot karein

steps.title: Daily life and review
steps.detail: Practise dressing, toilet and car transfers with the aids as advised, plan return to walking, driving and work with the surgeon, and review progress at six and twelve weeks. || Rozmarra aur review

text.en: **Surgeon's rules, patient's reasons.** Follow the surgeon's precautions, but always explain why they exist so the patient can protect the hip in unplanned moments, like reaching for the floor.
text.ur: **Surgeon ke qawaid, mareez ki wajuhat.** Surgeon ki ehtiyatein maanein, magar hamesha wajah samjhayein taake mareez ghair mutawaqqa lamhon mein bhi hip ko bacha sake, jaise farsh se cheez uthana.

text.en: **Teaching only the "don'ts".** A list of banned movements frightens patients into stillness. Show what they can do (walk, strengthen, climb stairs) and give safe ways to do daily tasks, such as a long-handled reacher and a raised toilet seat.
text.ur: **Sirf "mat karo" sikhana.** Mana harkaton ki fehrist mareezon ko dara kar be-harkat kar deti hai. Dikhayein woh kya kar sakte hain (chalna, mazboot karna, seedhiyan chadhna) aur rozmarra kaam ke mehfooz tareeqe dein, maslan lambay dastay wala reacher aur oonchi toilet seat.

text.en: **Walk, strengthen, repeat.** Most people recover well with a simple plan: short frequent walks, a few hip exercises and a stair plan. Give a written programme with a weekly goal and warn about the signs that mean calling the team. Return to driving and sport follows the surgeon's advice.
text.ur: **Chalein, mazboot karein, dohrayein.** Zyada tar log saade plan se achha theek hote hain: chhote baar baar chakkar, kuch hip exercises aur seedhiyon ka plan. Hafta war maqsad ke saath likha hua programme dein aur woh nishaniyan batayein jin par team ko call karna hai. Gaari chalana aur khel par wapsi surgeon ke mashware ke mutabiq hogi.

question.en: Why do hip precautions differ between surgeons?
question.ur: Hip ehtiyatein surgeons mein mukhtalif kyun hoti hain?

answer.en: The risk of dislocation depends on the surgical approach, the implant, the soft tissue repair and the patient's own factors. Some surgeons keep strict precautions for weeks, others relax or drop them, as evidence has not shown that strict rules always prevent dislocation. Follow the instructions that the surgeon has given for that patient.
answer.ur: Dislocation ka khatra surgical approach, implant, narm tissue ki marammat aur mareez ke apne asbaab par munhasir hai. Kuch surgeons haftay tak sakht ehtiyatein rakhte hain, kuch narm ya khatam kar dete hain, kyunke evidence ne yeh sabit nahi kiya ke sakht qawaid hamesha dislocation rokte hain. Wohi hidayat maanein jo surgeon ne us mareez ke liye di hai.

beats.patient: A 62-year-old man is two days after a posterior-approach hip replacement. He walks with a frame, manages the bed and chair, but is afraid to move the leg and sits all day.
beats.assessment: He has no signs of problems; fear of moving is the main barrier, and the risks of immobility are real.
beats.treatment: Review the precautions with him, show safe ways to move and dress, start gluteal sets and standing abduction, set walking goals and plan a visit in a week.
beats.reassess: At two weeks he walks with one stick, climbs stairs safely and is confident with his routine.

text.en: **Contact the surgical team urgently** for sudden severe hip pain with a shortened or turned leg (possible dislocation), a hot, red, swollen wound or fever, a hot, swollen, tender calf, chest pain or sudden breathlessness (emergency), numbness or weakness in the foot, or a fall with pain and inability to bear weight.
text.ur: **Surgical team ko foran batayein** achanak shadeed hip dard ke saath chhoti ya mudi hui taang (mumkin dislocation), garam, surkh, soojha hua zakhm ya bukhar, garam, soojhi hui, dardnak pindli, seene ka dard ya achanak saans ki tangi (emergency), pair mein sunn hona ya kamzori, ya girne ke baad dard aur wazan na utha pana.

summary.en: Mobilise early, follow the surgeon's written precautions and explain why they exist; precautions differ with the surgical approach.
summary.ur: Jaldi harkat karwayein, surgeon ki likhi ehtiyatein maanein aur wajah samjhayein; ehtiyatein surgical approach ke saath mukhtalif hoti hain.

summary.en: Strengthen the hip with gluteal sets, bridging, standing abduction, sit-to-stand, step-ups and walking, progressing aids from frame to stick to none.
summary.ur: Gluteal sets, bridging, standing abduction, sit-to-stand, step-ups aur chalne se hip mazboot karein, sahare ko frame se chhari phir koi nahi tak barhate hue.

summary.en: Know the emergencies: dislocation, infection, a clot and chest pain or breathlessness need urgent medical help.
summary.ur: Emergencies jaanein: dislocation, infection, clot aur seene ka dard ya saans ki tangi ko foran medical madad chahiye.
